feature_regressions: A missing daemon is started on demand as the calling account: no sudo, prompt, installer or service manager.
Healthy daemons are only probed; no systemctl, launchctl, schtasks or ting-daemon subprocess.
Installed services are asked with systemctl --no-ask-password only, then replaced by an on-demand daemon if they stay down.
Concurrent starters serialize on ~/.ting-daemon/startup.lock and leave exactly one daemon.
Spawned daemons lead their own session, read /dev/null and write only ~/.ting-daemon/daemon.log.
A socket directory owned by another account returns daemon_identity_mismatch and spawns nothing.
SIGTERM removes daemon.sock; after SIGKILL the next command replaces the stale socket.
ting-daemon --version exits 0 and unknown arguments exit 2 without creating the socket.
